text.p: Brokerage KB Securities, part of the Belgian Kredietbank group, said it rated shares in insurer Fortis AG 'accumulate'.
KB Securities said first quarter results were better than expected, adding it raised its forecasts for full year earnings.

Profit growth this year would come from growth in business and a net contribution of the MeesPierson acquisition, which is being consolidated from January 1 on and to a smaller extent from an increased stake in ASLK-CGER Bank and Insurance.
"We expect Fortis AG, and the financial sector as a whole, to consolidate at curent price levels although the momentum in the sector is still positive," KB Securities said in its report.

Turbulence in interest rates, in the run-up of the start of economic and monetary union in Europe, would result in higher volatility in the sector. "We nevertheless confirm our accumulate recommendation," it said.
Estimates (based on Aug 6 share price of 7,720 francs)
NOTE - * bottom-line profit; report by KB Securities analyst Dirk Peeters +32 2 546 40 96
